focus.title: Funded to build. Preparing the next education rollout.
focus.body: Public priorities after SaintSal AI’s announced pre-seed close: more integrations, better voice agents, a smarter Saint CRM and the Xtudy education rollout.

updates.title: SaintSal AI announces pre-seed close
updates.body: SaintSal AI’s public company posts announce a $3.566 million pre-seed close and identify integrations, voice agents and Saint CRM as investment priorities.

updates.title: Education partnership and user milestone announced
updates.body: SaintSal AI announced an Xtudy education partnership and said Sal was live with 5,000 users that week. The same post presents 30,000 users as the next target, not a current total.

updates.title: SaintSal™ across your screens
updates.body: The official download hub lists Mac, Windows, iPhone, iPad and the browser extension, alongside the web experience.

updates.title: Company knowledge, with people in control
updates.body: SaintSal’s public product materials describe company knowledge, configurable guardrails and model routing as foundations of the experience.

updates.title: Founder vision. Technical leadership.
updates.body: Ryan introduced Ritik Rohan as co-founder, CTO and Director of Technology Development in his public company announcement.
